title: G6/B2 e0 dynamic-slot frame and datum binding supplement (56/64 slot set, offline, no budget)
claim_text: Evidence binding only. Frame is bound for 25 of the 56 dynamic slots and datum for 10, strictly from committed text; every other field is null with a precise owner-decision reason.
